_about: Curated artists for the Popular Artists music mode (src/popular_artists.py, prepare_popular_artists.py).
Separate from config/artist_priority.json and from the 278k catalog: these names are matched against the
local 2024 multilingual dataset (data/external/popular_artists_2024/, see DATA.md) only.
A track belongs to an artist only when that exact name appears in the dataset's artist string as a
complete comma-separated entry (case-sensitive): 'Pritam' never matches 'Pritam Chakraborty'.
Each name was checked against the dataset on 2026-10-10. Categories are used only to balance a list
internally; they are never sent to the browser or shown.
